source: 695 Kolobo’s Worry
target: 695 Sollicitudo Kolobo

source: Lumian snapped out of his daze and glanced at Ludwig, who had regained his composure.
target: Lumian ex stupore evigilavit et Ludovicum intuebatur, qui sibi constantiam redemit.

source: Turning to Lugano, who was shrinking into a corner of the bed, he said, “We’ll head back to Trier tomorrow and find a psychiatrist for you—a real, genuine one.”
target: Conversus ad Lugano, qui in angulum lecti contrahere videbatur, dixit: “Cras ad Trier redibimus et tibi medicum mentis reperiemus—verum atque genuinum!”

source: This decision wasn’t made out of concern for Lugano, but rather something that had long been on Lumian’s agenda.
target: Haec decisio non ex cura erga Lugano facta est, sed ex re, quae diu in consilio Lumiani iam manebat.

source: 007 should have already provided feedback in the early morning hours.
target: 007 iam debuerat responsum ferre in primis horis matutinis.

source: Lumian, Franca, and the others would discuss how to handle the Mirror Person, Moran Avigny.
target: Lumian, Franca et ceteri disputabunt quomodo tractanda sit Persona Specularis, Moran Avigny.

source: Moreover, Lumian intended to seize this opportunity to extract Termiboros’s power and obtain a Fate Appropriator boon.
target: Praeterea, Lumian intendebat hanc opportunitatem capere ad extrahendam vim Termibori et obtinendum donum Fati Appropriatoris.

source: His most significant gain from the Dream Festival was the substantial digestion of the Reaper potion.
target: Maximus eius fructus ex Festival Somniorum fuit ingens digestio potionis Messoris.

source: He knew the Southern Continent was filled with conflicts and combat opportunities, which would help him digest the Reaper potion.
target: Sciebat Continentem Meridionalem esse repletam certaminibus et occasionibus belli, quae ei in digestione potionis Messoris favere poterant.

source: However, he never anticipated that less than two weeks after advancing, the potion’s digestion progress would skyrocket, much like a mercury thermometer’s column shooting up when touching a living person’s armpit.
target: Tamen numquam existimavit, post minus quam duas hebdomadas profectionis, progressum digestionis potionis in caelum proferi, instar columnae thermometri mercurialis quae, minimo incitamento in axillam hominis vivi contingens, subito ascendit.

source: Culling Padre Cali, Hisoka’s dream projection, and nearly 20 others bestowed with strength equivalent to Sequence 6 or Sequence 5 made Lumian acutely aware of life’s fragility.
target: Exstirpatio Patris Cali, proiectionis somniorum Hisoka, atque circiter viginti aliorum, quorum vires erant aequales Sequentiae VI vel V, Lumiani acutissime de fragilitate vitae animadvertitionem effecit.

source: It was like straw under a scythe, constantly collapsing with a simple cull and scattered by the wind.
target: Erat quasi palea sub falce, quae simplici caede constanter corruens ventis dispersa esset.

source: Furthermore, after experiencing the acting of the first four Sequences, Lumian felt the Hunter pathway had a distinct characteristic of bringing calamity.
target: Praeterea, postquam actus primarum quattuor Sequentiarum perceptus est, Lumian sensit iter Venatoris notum esse calamitatem afferendi.

source: Reapers were no exception.
target: Messori exceptionem non habebant.

source: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com
target: B0x𝔫oѵ𝑒𝙡.com

source: With this acting, he believed the Reaper’s destructive characteristics that brought calamity were more apparent.
target: Hoc actu, credidit lineamenta destructiva Messoris, quae calamitatem afferent, magis apparere.

source: At the same time, Lumian greatly benefited from an enemy’s destruction.
target: Simul, Lumian ex interitu hostis valde profuit.

source: As his mind raced, he summarized his first Reaper acting principle: “Culling is about destroying the target and reaping a harvest for yourself.”
target: Mentem celeriter currentem, primum praeceptum actus Messoris summatim exposuit: “Exstirpatio consistit in destinatum delendo et messem sibi metendo.”

source: If I had three or four more similar culls, I wouldn’t need to comprehend other acting principles and put them into practice to digest the Reaper potion.
target: Si tres vel quattuor similes exstirpatio haberem, non necesse esset alias rationes actuum intellegere atque ad potionem Messoris digerendam exercere.

source: However, such good fortune is rare… Lumian sighed silently.
target: Tamen, talis fortuna rara est… Lumian tacite suspiravit.

source: This required gathering more than ten Sequence 6 and Sequence 5 Beyonders with obvious flaws he could exploit without interference.
target: Hoc requirebat congregare plus quam decem Beyonderum Sequentiae VI et V, quorum vitia manifesta erant, quibus ipse sine impedimento uti posset.

source: Meeting each of these conditions was challenging, let alone all of them simultaneously:
target: Singulas has condiciones exsequenda arduum erat, quanto magis omnes simul.

source: First and foremost, whether humans consumed potions or gained superpowers through boons, their pathways and Sequences differed in their flaws.
target: Primum et maxime, sive homines potiones consumebant sive per dona virtutes supernas adipiscebantur, vias et Sequentias in vitiosis differenti habebant.

source: They couldn’t all be burdened by dream projections like the gravekeepers in the Dream Festival, where emotions and desires exploded at the slightest trigger.
target: Non omnes possent oneri proiectionum somniorum esse onerati, sicut custodes sepulcri in Festival Somniorum, ubi affectus et desideria parvo incitamento erupta sunt.

source: Even if the bestowed were deeply influenced by evil gods and had mental issues to some degree, exploding emotions and desires weren’t inevitable.
target: Etiam, si donati a diis malignis profunde afficerentur et in aliquo modo perturbationes mentales haberent, eruptio affectuum et cupiditatum inevitabilis non erat.

source: Some might simply have mutated personalities.
target: Aliqui fortasse personalitates mutatas habeant.

source: Secondly, Sequence 6 and Sequence 5 Beyonders were uncommon, especially the latter, who formed the backbone of various factions.
target: Secundo, Beyonder de Sequentia VI et V rarae erant, praesertim illi de Sequentia V, qui columen variarum factionum constituebant.

source: Even without factions, they could create their own teams and dominate a region like the Pirate Admirals.
target: Etiam sine factionibus, turmas suas constituere poterant et regionem dominari, ut admirales piratarum.

source: Gathering more than ten to twenty such Beyonders was no easy task.
target: Congregare plus quam decem ad viginti talium Beyonderum non erat munus facile.

source: Moreover, if a major incident caused the first two conditions to be met, the Beyonders’ common flaws might not be countered by Lumian and his mystical items.
target: Praeterea, si magnum casus efficeret ut prima duo requisita implerentur, vitia communia Beyonderum a Lumiano et ornamentis mysticis non repellerentur.

source: Finally, during the battle, a Sequence 5 Beyonder, a key member of the various factions, might draw the attention of the corresponding demigod.
target: Denique, in proelio, Beyonder Sequentiae V, membrum praecipuum variarum factionum, fortasse attentionem semi-dei congruentes attraheret.

source: A mysticism event like the Dream Festival, with its inherent limitations and natural problems, was unusually suitable for Lumian.
target: Eventus mysticus ut Festival Somniorum, cum limitationibus immanentibus atque quaestionibus naturalibus, inusitate Lumiano conveniebat.

source: Perhaps there had only been one such event in the Northern and Southern Continents in nearly a millennium.
target: Forsitan solus unus talis eventus per paene mille annos in Continento Septentrionali et Meridionali fuisset.

source: Sigh… Lumian couldn’t help but sigh again.
target: Suspiro… Lumian iterum suspiravit.

source: At that moment, Lugano was thrilled to hear he could return to Trier at dawn.
target: Illo momento, Lugano exsultabat ex auditu quod ad Trier, in aurora, redire posset.

source: He quickly replied, “Alright, alright!”
target: Celeriter respondit: “Ita, ita!”

source: Back in Trier, his boss had more trusted companions.
target: Reversus in Trier, patronus eius plures fideles comites habebat.

source: He probably wouldn’t need to take care of Ludwig anymore!
target: Forte Ludovicum curare non iam oportebit!

source: Lumian thought for a moment and glanced at the curtains emanating the crimson moonlight.
target: Lumian paulisper meditatus est et cortinas, quae lunam rubram efferebant, intuebatur.

source: Casually, he asked Lugano, “Have you saved enough for the Harvest Priest potion formula and the corresponding ingredients?”
target: Leve rogavit Lugano: “Num satis seruisti ad formulam potionis Sacerdotis Messis et ingredienta necessariis?”

source: Lugano was taken aback.
target: Lugano obstupefactus est.

source: “No, I’m still a bit short of the potion formula’s price.”
target: “Non, adhuc paulo deest pretium formulae potionis.”

source: Most of his current “savings” came from Lumian, amounting to around 15,000 verl d’or.
target: Plerumque pecuniae “savings” eius ex Lumiano orta erant, circiter 15,000 verl d’or pendentes.

source: Based on his knowledge, a Sequence 7 potion formula usually cost between 16,000 to 20,000 verl d’or.
target: Ex scientia eius, formula potionis Sequentiae VII usitate inter 16,000 et 20,000 verl d’or constabat.

source: Lumian nodded pensively.
target: Lumian pensiter annuit.

source: “I’ll keep an eye out for the Harvest Priest potion formula and the necessary ingredients for you.
target: “Tibi formulam potionis Sacerdotis Messis et ingredienta necessaria observabo.

source: If you’re short on funds, I’ll help cover the difference.
target: Si pecunia deficit, differentiam subveniam tibi.

source: Consider it a share of the spoils from this adventure.”
target: Existima id partem praedae huius incepti.

source: Lugano was stunned momentarily before tears welled up in his eyes, blurring his vision.
target: Lugano per momentum attonitus fuit, et postea lacrimae in oculis eius eruperunt, visionem confundentes.

source: I made the right choice!
target: Rectam electionem feci!

source: My future truly lies with the boss!
target: Futurum meum vere cum patrono meo iacet!

source: With a hint of unease, he asked, “But that was a dream adventure.
target: Cum levissima inquietudine, rogavit: “Sed illa erat adventura somniorum.

source: Can the gains be brought back to the real world?”
target: Num haec beneficia ad rem veram revocari possint?”

source: Lumian didn’t elaborate.
target: Lumian non ampliavit.

source: He retrieved Hisoka’s golden mask from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Larvam auream Hisokae ex sacco viatoris sustulit.

source: It’s possible… Some special items are possible?
target: Fieri potest… Quaedam res speciales fieri possunt?

source: Lugano felt a sense of relief.
target: Lugano solacium sensit.

source: Lumian turned to Ludwig, who seemed to have acquired a cherished toy, and nodded slightly.
target: Lumian ad Ludovicum convertebat, qui ludum carum adeptus videbatur, et leviter annuit.

source: “You may go back to sleep.”
target: “Redi ad somnum.”

source: Ludwig, wearing a blue nightcap, blinked and reached out to touch his stomach.
target: Ludovicus, galeam nocturnam caeruleam indutus, palpebravit atque manum extendit ad ventrem suum tangendum.

source: Groan.
target: Gemitus.

source: Groan.
target: Gemitus.

source: His stomach churned violently.
target: Venter eius vehementer agitabatur.

source: Lumian laughed self-deprecatingly and took out the portion of food Ludwig had eaten in the dream, including almond pistachio cream cake, liquor‐infused chocolate, éclairs, and more.
target: Lumian se ipsius contemnens risit et portionem cibi, quam Ludovicus in somnio consumpsit, extraxit—inter quae erant placenta cum crema amygdalina et pistachio, socolata liquoribus infusa, éclairs et cetera.

source: After Ludwig began his “quiet” meal, Lumian returned to his room and conjured a blazing white fireball.
target: Postquam Ludovicus suum “quietum” convivium inceperat, Lumian ad conclave suum rediit et globum ignis albi ardentis conjuravit.

source: He unfolded the letter, picked up a fountain pen, and penned a letter to Madam Magician.
target: Epistulam explicavit, calamus arripuit, et ad Dominam Magicianam scripsit.

source: This took precedence over dealing with other matters.
target: Hoc praecipuum fuit super aliis rebus agendis.

source: As he wrote, Lumian pondered something.
target: Dum scribebat, Lumian aliquid meditabatur.

source: If I killed all the elders of the gravekeepers, would the primitive tribe still possess the ability to attack and eliminate the dead?
target: Si omnes seniores custodum sepulchri interfecerim, num tribus primitiva adhuc poterit mortuos oppugnare et extinguere?

source: Or are they still alive in the real world, waiting to drag those already dead down with them when they attack Tizamo?
target: An in mundo vero adhuc vivunt, exspectantes ut mortuos, qui iam sunt, trahant cum Tizamo oppugnatione?

source: Or would the deceased find another way out, like the fire that had engulfed the Twanaku family?
target: Aut defuncti aliam exitum invenirent, sicut ignis qui familiam Twanaku consumpsit?

source: On the third floor of the police headquarters in Tizamo Town.
target: In plano tertio praetorii vigilum in oppido Tizamo.

source: Camus snapped out of his reverie and instinctively glanced at the temporary bed opposite him.
target: Camus ex meditatione evexit et instinctive ad lectum temporarium oppositum oculos intulit.

source: He noticed the blanket had been lifted, and Kolobo was nowhere to be found.
target: Animadvertit stragulum sublatum esse, et Kolobo nusquam inveniri.

source: Am I still dreaming, still in the Dream Festival?
target: Num adhuc somnio, num in Festival Somniorum versor?

source: Camus sat up cautiously and heard a sound near the door in the corner.
target: Camus caute surrexit et sonum iuxta ostium in angulo audivit.

source: In the darkness, under the crimson moonlight seeping through the curtains, he saw Kolobo crouched there, curled up and trembling.
target: In tenebris, sub rubro lumine lunari per cortinas effuso, vidit Kolobo ibi se congregare, contrahitum et tremulum.

source: Camus lowered his voice and gently asked, “What’s wrong?”
target: Camus vocem demisit et leniter rogavit: “Quid accidit?”

source: Kolobo’s voice quivered as he replied, “The sky is falling! The sky is falling!”
target: Voce tremula, Kolobo respondit: “Caelum cadit! Caelum cadit!”

source: The sky is falling?
target: Caelum cadit?

source: Camus found it amusing and looked at Kolobo.
target: Camus id ridiculum putavit et ad Kolobo aspexit.

source: “Did you misinterpret your premonition?”
target: “Praemonitionem tuam male interpretatus es?”

source: How could the sky possibly fall?
target: Quomodo potest caelum cadere?

source: Outside Tizamo, at the edge of the primitive forest.
target: Extra Tizamo, in margine silvae primitivae.

source: Maslow, his face adorned with white paint, slowly advanced into the forest.
target: Maslow, cuius facies albo pigmento ornata erat, lente in silvam procedit.

source: It was a terrible feeling to know about his impending yet unavoidable death.
target: Horrendum erat scire de morte imminente et inevitabili sua.

source: He regretted betraying the Numinous Episcopate, but there had been no choice.
target: De proditione Episcopatus Numinosi paenitebat, sed alia via non erat.

source: Shortly after arriving in Tizamo, he had been secretly controlled by Twanaku, who had returned for a “vacation.”
target: Mox post adventum in Tizamo, secretim a Twanaku imperatus erat, qui ad “vacationem” redierat.

source: He had become a fallen one monitoring the situation of Padre Cali and Tizamo.
target: Factus est lapsus, qui statum Patris Cali et Tizamo vigilabat.

source: Subsequently, although he knew Twanaku had been killed, the other party’s dream projection appeared in his dream, telling him the matter wasn’t over.
target: Subsequentia, quamquam sciebat Twanaku interfectum esse, proiection somniorum alterius partis in somnio ei apparuit, dicens rem nondum finitam esse.

source: Maslow advanced step by step, yearning to return to the forest and become nourishment for a tree, just like his ancestors.
target: Maslow gradatim processit, desiderans in silvam redire atque arbori nutrimentum esse, sicut maiores eius.

source: As he walked, he spotted nearly 20 people emerging from the nearby barracks.
target: Dum ambulabat, vidit fere viginti homines ex castris proximis emergentes.

source: The men seemed to sense something amiss and prepared to inspect their surroundings.
target: Homines videbantur aliquid iniurium sentire et ad circumiecta perscrutanda parati erant.

source: At that moment, Maslow felt the night suddenly brighten.
target: In illo momento, Maslow sentit noctem subitam fulgere.

source: Subconsciously, he looked up at the sky and saw a burning boulder descending with a crimson flame tail.
target: Subconscie, oculos in caelum levavit et vidit lapidem ardentem descendere cum cauda flammae rubrae.

source: In an instant, the burning boulder filled Maslow’s vision.
target: In momento, lapis ardens totam visionem Maslow obsedit.

source: It crashed into the area between the forest’s edge and the barracks.
target: Percussit aream inter limitem silvae et castra.

source: Rumble!
target: Fragor!

source: The wind and dust stirred by the meteorite swiftly filled the area, rising into the air and dissipating, obscuring the crimson moon and the starlight.
target: Ventus et pulvis, a meteoro excitati, celeriter aream compleverunt, sursum in aethera ascendentes et evanidi, lunam rubram et lucem stellarum obfuscantes.

source: Rumble!
target: Fragor!

source: The entirety of Tizamo seemed to experience a violent earthquake.
target: Totum Tizamo videtur violentum terrae motum passum esse.

source: Buildings shook violently, and glass shattered.
target: Aedificia vehementer concutebantur, et vitrum confractum est.

source: Several houses with weak foundations quickly collapsed, burying their occupants.
target: Nonnullae domus cum fundamentis debilibus celeriter corruerunt, suis incolis intermergentes.

source: With great difficulty, Camus regained his balance.
target: Magno labore, Camus balanciam suam restituit.

source: Once the building stabilized, he rushed to the shattered window and looked out.
target: Postquam aedificium stabilitum est, festinavit ad fenestram fractam et extrinsecus conspexit.

source: He saw the “sky” was gray and murky, so close he could touch it if he jumped up.
target: Vidit caelum esse cinereum et turbido, tam prope ut tangere posset, si saliret.

source: The “sky” has really fallen…
target: Caelum vere cecidit…

source: For some inexplicable reason, this thought flashed through Camus’s mind.
target: Ob causam inexplicabilem, haec cogitatio per mentem Camus fulsit.

source: In the second-floor suite of the Brieu Motel.
target: In conclavi secundo Brieu Motel.

source: Clutching the letter and fountain pen, Lumian watched the smoke and dust outside with amusement, sensing the “heavy blow” not far away.
target: Epistulam et calam tenens, Lumian extra fume et pulverem oblectabatur, sentiens ictum grave non longe venturum esse.

source: “How direct…” he sighed sincerely.
target: “Quam directe…” suspiravit sincere.

source: A meteorite had descended from the sky!
target: Meteorus de caelo descenderat!

source: From the looks of it, the catastrophe had likely eliminated most of the deceased.
target: Ex imagine, catastropha verisimiliter plerosque defunctos deleverat.

source: Lumian turned to look at the door, which had swung open due to the building’s shaking, and saw Ludwig still focused on eating.
target: Lumian ad ostium conversus est, quod motu aedificii aperitum erat, et vidit Ludovicum adhuc cibum edere incumbens.

source: Nothing from the pile of food had fallen to the ground.
target: Nihil e acervi cibi ad terram cecidit.

source: After sending Lugano out to assist the injured, Lumian returned to his room and continued writing.
target: Postquam Lugano ad vulneratos adiuvandos mittebat, Lumian ad conclave suum rediit et scribere perrexit.

source: Upon completion, he immediately set up a ritual and summoned the “doll” messenger.
target: Post completionem, statim ritum instituit et nuntium “pupae” convocavit.

source: Just as the “doll” messenger emerged from the expanding candle flame, it suddenly shrank.
target: Ita, cum nuntius “pupae” e flamma candelae dilatante emergeret, subito contraxit.

source: Slowly, she glanced to her left and then to her right.
target: Lente, ad sinistram spectavit, deinde ad dexteram.

source: After confirming there was no problem, she tiptoed and cautiously approached Lumian’s letter.
target: Postquam confirmavit nullum esse impedimentum, super digitos ambulavit et, caute, ad epistulam Lumiani accessit.

source: Lumian had never seen the “doll” messenger act like this before.
target: Lumian numquam antea nuntium “pupae” talem se habere vidit.

source: He watched in confusion and amusement as she picked up the folded letter like a thief.
target: Contemplatus est, confundens atque delectatus, dum illa epistulam involutam quasi fur evassit.

source: She waved at him and quickly retreated into the candle flame.
target: Illa ei salutavit et celeriter in flammam candelae rediit.

source: Lumian chuckled and shook his head, no longer pondering the “doll” messenger’s actions.
target: Lumian risit et caput concussit, nec amplius de actis nuntii “pupae” meditabatur.

source: At the very least, it seemed harmless, and he had several things to do.
target: Saltem, videbatur id esse innocuum, atque multa habebat agenda.

source: Lumian left the bedroom, entered the corridor, and went to the first floor.
target: Lumian conclave reliquit, in corridorum ingressus est et ad primum planum processit.

source: He grabbed the motel owner, who had come out to check on the situation after waking up, and asked, “Which room are the lady and her companion who arrived tonight staying in?”
target: Lumian dominum motel, qui post excitandum ad rem perscrutandam exiit, apprehendit et rogavit: “In qua cella manent domina et comitissa eius, quae hac nocte advenerunt?”
